say:1:1660208001:0.text: ... Lyca? What... what happened to her?
say:1:1660208001:0.source_cn: ……莱卡巡游长，她怎么会变成那个样子？

say:2:1660208002:0.text: You tell Ludovic that it wasn't Lyca at all, but a nightmare in her likeness, trying to stop you from breaking the spring curse. Ludovic isn't fully convinced.
say:2:1660208002:0.source_cn: 你向柳博米尔解释，那不是莱卡，而是想要阻止你解除春日诅...
say:2:1660208002:0.male: You tell Ludovic that it wasn't Lyca at all, but a nightmare in her likeness, trying to stop you from breaking the spring curse. Ludovic isn't fully convinced.
say:2:1660208002:0.female: You tell Ludovic that it wasn't Lyca at all, but a nightmare in her likeness, trying to stop you from breaking the spring curse. Ludovic isn't fully convinced.

say:3:1660208003:0.text: You really think you can do it? Break the curse? End the crying and pain?
say:3:1660208003:0.source_cn: 你真的能做到吗？消除春日诅咒，让人们不再哀哭？
say:3:1660208003:0.male: You really think you can do it? Break the curse? End the crying and pain?
say:3:1660208003:0.female: You really think you can do it? Break the curse? End the crying and pain?

choice_prompt:4:1660208003.female: You really think you can do it? Break the curse? End the crying and pain?

say:5:1660208004:1.text: I don't get it... but something deep down tells me you might be right...
say:5:1660208004:1.source_cn: 我不明白……但我有种说不清的感觉，或许你所说的是真的……
say:5:1660208004:1.male: I don't get it... but something deep down tells me you might be right...
say:5:1660208004:1.female: I don't get it... but something deep down tells me you might be right...

say:6:1660208005:1.text: If a song is what it takes to break the curse, then by all means, sing it out loud. Maybe your voice is exactly what this broken land needs.
say:6:1660208005:1.source_cn: 若歌声能驱散诅咒，那么就唱出它吧。或许你的歌声能给这片...
say:6:1660208005:1.male: If a song is what it takes to break the curse, then by all means, sing it out loud. Maybe your voice is exactly what this broken land needs.
say:6:1660208005:1.female: If a song is what it takes to break the curse, then by all means, sing it out loud. Maybe your voice is exactly what this broken land needs.

say:7:1660208006:1.text: Tell me, what will you sing?
say:7:1660208006:1.source_cn: 告诉我，你要唱诵什么歌曲？
say:7:1660208006:1.male: Tell me, what will you sing?
say:7:1660208006:1.female: Tell me, what will you sing?

choice_prompt:8:1660208006.text: Tell me, what will you sing?

choice_prompt:8:1660208006.male: Tell me, what will you sing?
choice_prompt:8:1660208006.female: Tell me, what will you sing?

say:9:1660208007:1.text: The melody drifts through the stone hall, and it feels as though the air is growing colder with every note.
say:9:1660208007:1.source_cn: 冬日之歌的声音在石质的大殿上盘旋，周边的气温似乎都在变冷。

say:10:1660208008:1.text: Then you realize it's no illusion. The white flowers, the coffins, the throne—everything around you is frosting over with ice, cracking into pieces as the wind sweeps through.
say:10:1660208008:1.source_cn: 接着，你意识到这并非错觉。周边的白花、棺材、王座都随着...
say:10:1660208008:1.male: Then you realize it's no illusion. The white flowers, the coffins, the throne—everything around you is frosting over with ice, cracking into pieces as the wind sweeps through.
say:10:1660208008:1.female: Then you realize it's no illusion. The white flowers, the coffins, the throne—everything around you is frosting over with ice, cracking into pieces as the wind sweeps through.

say:11:1660208009:4.text: When the song ends, the guards, the servants, and the castle all disappear. It's just you and Ludovic now, in a garden in full bloom.
say:11:1660208009:4.source_cn: 随着歌声结束，侍卫、仆人和城堡都消失了，你和柳博米尔站...
say:11:1660208009:4.male: When the song ends, the guards, the servants, and the castle all disappear. It's just you and Ludovic now, in a garden in full bloom.
say:11:1660208009:4.female: When the song ends, the guards, the servants, and the castle all disappear. It's just you and Ludovic now, in a garden in full bloom.

say:13:1660208010:0.text: Before Ludovic can speak, that falling sensation returns. Before darkness consumes you, a single petal drifts down past your eyes.
say:13:1660208010:0.source_cn: 还不等柳博米尔开口，熟悉的下坠感传来。在黑暗遮蔽一切前...

say:15:1660208011:1.text: You lunge forward and catch the petal just in time. The world gives way beneath your feet. Ludovic falls with you.
say:15:1660208011:1.source_cn: 你一跃而起，将它牢牢抓在手中，和柳博米尔一起坠入了黑暗里。
